WHO GO WEST UNPREPARED

I DONT UNDERSTAND...

YOU ARE NOT CARRYING THE 
CORRECT POSSESSIONS

I HAVE BEEN ROASTED ALIVE...
THIS IS THE END OF THE ADVENTURE

YOU HAVE SUCCESFULLY COMPLETED 

THIS ADVENTURE. WELL DONE
NOW TRY OUR NEXT ONE:ADVENTURE C

FOR HIGH QUALITY SOFTWARE FOR YOUR COMPUTER YOU SHOULD GO TO
ARTIC COMPUTING
MAIN STREET
